product_metadata.title: Yunko Cake Leaves Baking Pie Crust Cutters Set of 4
features: Perfect Combination - Including 4 pcs leaf shaped cookie cutters,maple, oak,double leaf and basic Leaf which can satisfy your basic needs.
Safe Material - This leaf fondant cutter is made of food grade plastic,well packaged in a box.
Easy to Use - Plunger Cookie Cutters feature a sprung plunger which is super easy and fast to use.
Mini Size - Each cookie stamper measures aprox. 2" with great leaf design details.Hand wash and dry thoroughly.
Multi-purpose - The pie leaf cutter is great for pie gum paste, fondant, chocolate and more,help you make the perfect Autumn, harvest or Thanksgiving pie.
